done_when: The commit forge doctor --fix writes for its dated forge-files fix carries a Proof list paragraph naming that fix's Done-when and its evidence (the files it brought up to date from the pinned release's sync, and close's test run), so its first review gets a proof list; it reuses whatever forge upgrade's proof list uses rather than a second copy; a command test runs doctor --fix on a new repo and on one adopted on an earlier release and shows the paragraph reaching close's review; new and existing client repos get it from this release on
why: A client's forge doctor --fix fix fails its first review asking for a Proof list, because the commit doctor --fix writes has none, the same gap forge upgrade had (reported by a client session on v1.2.7)
